title: Approve this file change?

details: Review the exact change before the agent commits or opens a pull request.

sections.title: AGENT_INTEGRATION.md
sections.body: Clarifies that approval cards must include the exact draft, diff, command, recipient, risk, or attachment.

risks: Documentation change affects how agents create cards
metadata.diff:
--- a/AGENT_INTEGRATION.md
+++ b/AGENT_INTEGRATION.md
@@
